categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/torcontrol.cpp to fix Tor control port authentication, which is part of Tor network integration.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where passwords containing backslashes fail Tor control port authentication and prevent onion service creation. As noted in the description, master fails to escape backslashes according to the Tor control specification, causing 'tor: Authentication failed' when passwords contain backslashes.
